verdict: PASS mathematical model-transfer review; no new Lean compilation
scope: Every exact proper backward binary monotone Petersen circuit, including the earliest exact target prefix of a padded encoder trace, has at least six AND gates. No ownership, star-profile, or minimality assumption is needed for this count cut.
derivation: Encoder lines103-105 generate exactly the fifteen unordered Petersen edges in L_meta_635 lines2334-2336, with identical vertex labels; no graph isomorphism is needed.

A prefix ending at its first exact target is a CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit with the original ten inputs, binary AND/OR gates and backward references, hence satisfies Monotone2. Let A be exactly its AND gate indices; A.card is the encoder prefix AND count.

Positive edge pairs and all maximal independent-set negatives determine the whole monotone graph function: every true graph input contains a positive edge pair, and every false graph input extends to a maximal independent set. The encoder independently checks this maximal-set coverage at line112.

Accepted L_meta_217 private collapse_and_count (lines1422-1454) assumes Monotone2, exact graph-function equivalence, and inclusion of every AND index in A. It produces a well-formed AndCountCircuit D with D.size <= A.card and D.Computes G. Its statement has no t<=5, girth, cover, ownership, or minimality assumption. The t<=5 restriction belongs to the final L217 cover theorem, not this generic collapse.

For a proper binary circuit this collapse is also direct: express each input/OR wire as a disjunction of raw input variables and preceding AND outputs; each original AND becomes the AND of its two such sides; the final output is the corresponding disjunction. This retains exactly the original AND operations and satisfies the earlier-gate requirement.

By AndCountCircuit.Computes, D.eval I is false on every independent I. If I is maximal and u is outside I, maximality supplies v in I adjacent to u, so D.eval(insert u I) is true. This discharges precisely the MIS-boundary promise in L_meta_635 lines2340-2343.
The second conjunct of accepted L_meta_635 says every well-formed D satisfying that promise has not(D.size<=5). If A.card<=5, collapse gives D.size<=5, contradiction. Thus 6<=A.card.
The threshold belongs to the earliest exact prefix. Gates appended after that target cannot satisfy it. Existing v12 first_target_flags guards and count-DP replay enforce exactly this scope.
limits: This is an AND-count lower bound only. OR collapse makes OR operations free; it supplies neither a total-gate lower bound of20 nor a star-profile normalization.
The accepted collapse helper is private; this review uses its inspected mathematical statement and proof, not a claim that a new public Lean specialization has been compiled.
Petersen-specific six-AND strengthening should be guarded by the Petersen graph case; retain the previously reviewed generic bounds for other catalog graphs.
